hulls.name: Dinghy
hulls.description: One mast, a pair of oars and room for a friend.

hulls.name: Fishing boat
hulls.description: A working boat with a deep hold, slow and honest.

hulls.name: Merchant sloop
hulls.description: A fast single-master with room below for cargo and a few passengers.

hulls.name: Caravel
hulls.description: Three masts and a figurehead: the classic pirate ship.

hulls.name: Galleon
hulls.description: A great ship of the high seas, with cannon decks and a crew of dozens.

hulls.name: Marine warship
hulls.description: A battleship of the Marines' own plan, built to carry a hundred guns and survive them.

materials.name: Common wood
materials.description: Pine and fir from any island's forest: cheap, easy to work, and it rots in twenty years.

materials.name: Hardwood
materials.description: Oak and ironbark: heavier, slower to shape, and good for a lifetime.

materials.name: Iron plating
materials.description: A wooden ship sheathed in iron: shot glances off, but she sits low and sails slow.

materials.name: Treasure tree wood
materials.description: Wood of the treasure tree Adam, sold in pieces on the black market: the strongest timber in the world, and it never rots.

rigs.name: Square sails
rigs.description: Broad sails across the masts: fast before the wind, and a lot of rope to haul.

rigs.name: Fore-and-aft
rigs.description: Sails along the ship's length: closer to the wind, and fewer hands to work them.

rigs.name: Extra masts
rigs.description: More canvas than she was drawn for: faster, and hungry for crew.

drives.name: Oars
drives.description: Benches and sweeps for when the wind dies.

drives.name: Paddle wheels
drives.description: Wheels at her sides, turned by hand or engine: she moves in a dead calm.

drives.name: Burner
drives.description: A furnace below and a screw astern: steady speed with no wind at all.

drives.name: Burst system
drives.description: A great charge of air stored in the hull and let go at once: the ship leaps a mile through the sky.

drives.name: A tamed sea beast
drives.description: Harnessed to the bow, a beast of the deep that swims where no sail can.

rooms.name: Galley
rooms.description: A real kitchen: hot food at sea keeps a crew together.

rooms.name: Sick bay
rooms.description: Cots, clean linen and a cabinet of medicine.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves that do not spill in a storm, and a lamp to read by.

rooms.name: Aquarium
rooms.description: A tank of seawater below decks, with fish to watch and fish to eat.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.description: Benches, tools and a vice: crafting at sea.

rooms.name: Armoury
rooms.description: Racks of blades and guns: boarding parties go over armed.

rooms.name: Brig
rooms.description: A barred cell below the waterline, for those you mean to hand over.

rooms.name: Training deck
rooms.description: Weights, a sparring ring, room to move.

rooms.name: Lookout gym
rooms.description: A crow's nest big enough to train in.

rooms.name: Bath
rooms.description: Hot water at sea: a luxury worth more than it costs.

rooms.name: Bar
rooms.description: A counter, some stools and something to pour.

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.description: An iron-bound strongroom: robbers at sea take less.

rooms.name: Seastone keel
rooms.description: Seastone laid along the bottom of the hull: Sea Kings cannot sense her, and pass her by.

rooms.name: Boat dock
rooms.description: A launch for small boats inside the hull.

weapons.name: Cannon
weapons.description: A gun on each port: the backbone of a sea fight.

weapons.name: Bow cannon
weapons.description: One great gun in the bow for the shot that matters.

weapons.name: Harpoon guns
weapons.description: Lines and barbs to hold a ship close for boarding.

weapons.name: Ram
weapons.description: An iron beak at the waterline.

weapons.name: Great cannon
weapons.description: A weapon of legend, built into the ship itself, that can level a fortress.

figureheads.name: An animal
figureheads.description: A carved goat, a ram, a gull: something the crew can pat for luck.

figureheads.name: A fierce beast
figureheads.description: A lion, a dragon, a sea king's head: a bow that says who is coming.

figureheads.name: A symbol
figureheads.description: The crew's own mark carved large.

figureheads.name: A person
figureheads.description: A figure of someone loved or feared, looking out to sea.
